issue.title: Helm v3 helmfile apply issue
issue.body:

My helm version is `v3.0.0-beta.3`

```
Comparing release=ingx-to-sd, chart=stable/prometheus-to-sd
Comparing release=ingx, chart=stable/nginx-ingress
in ./helmfile.yaml: in .helmfiles[0]: in ../../../helmfiles/nginx-ingress/helmfile.yaml: 2 errors:
err 0: failed processing release ingx: helm exited with status 1:

err 1: failed processing release ingx-to-sd: helm exited with status 1:

```

issue.title: fix(v3): fix regression on non-zero plugin exist status

issue.body:
Fixes the regression in helm-3.0.0-beta.5 that swallows and rounds any non-zero exit status greater than 1 from a helm plugin to `1`.

This, for example, breaks `helm-diff` which relies on helm able to return `2` when `helm-diff` returned `2`.

Closese #6788

body:
> keep fixing it until v3 stable is out

? You mean if we can't write tests - keep fixing it when it breaks? We need to know if it breaks first, manually checking it is not feasible. I wouldn't advise it. 

I'll try to help with the tests for the PR. We can also get help from the maintainers. And in previous PRs also, I have refrained from submitting PRs without tests and maintainers also recommend it, an example - https://github.com/helm/helm/pull/6523#issuecomment-536603044

You can also come up with different ideas - anything, preferably something simple to test this - to make sure if someone breaks it, we know.

@karuppiah7890 All right. I've added the tests.

Please see the last two commints in #6790.

I won't say it's easy to understand at glance(It isn't straight-forward to write/read and that's why I don't usually write tests like that in my other projects).

But once you figure out you'd think it's simple and no better solution exists!
